mapping_rule: Only planet/house mappings independently returned by both sealed target-blind mappers are eligible. One-mapper-only mappings remain recorded disagreement and are not scored.

astronomy.ephemeris: Swiss Ephemeris local files; FLG_SWIEPH; hard fail on Moshier fallback

location.role: fixed known recovery location for every candidate

hellenistic_western.sect_day_rule: Sun in actual above-horizon Placidus houses 7-12 at fixed location
hellenistic_western.mercury_sect: abstain; Mercury's variable sect condition is not operationalized in this bounded registry
hellenistic_western.house_mapping_rule: No Hellenistic house mapping is scored unless it exists in the frozen consensus map; if one exists, use its whole-sign traditional lord and the same eligible lord conditions.
hellenistic_western.omission_reason: Keep the first V1.3 specification mechanically explicit and small; omitted choices are not selected or rejected by owner fit.

lilly_traditional_western.succedent_treatment: neutral in the primary V1.3 equal-testimony registry
lilly_traditional_western.house_mapping_rule: For a mapped house, use the traditional ruler of the tropical sign on that Placidus cusp; emit the same positive/negative lord-strength conditions.
lilly_traditional_western.omission_reason: Those require additional historically variant tables or numerical source-native weights; they remain possible separate specifications but are not silently mixed into this first no-custom-weight registry.

ayanamsha.name: Lahiri
ayanamsha.role: predeclared established sidereal reference; not selected by owner fit

parashari_jyotish.house_mapping_rule: For a mapped sidereal whole-sign house, use its traditional sign lord and emit the same positive/negative lord-strength conditions.
parashari_jyotish.special_graha_aspects: omitted from this first bounded registry
parashari_jyotish.omission_reason: The semantic consensus map identifies significators/houses, not aspect-specific domain relations; adding aspect choices before owner scoring would create another specification dimension.

atomic_testimony.planet_mapping: For every frozen domain/tradition planet mapping, each satisfied eligible positive strength condition emits one +1 atomic testimony and each satisfied eligible negative condition emits one -1 atomic testimony.
atomic_testimony.house_mapping: For every frozen domain/tradition house mapping, identify the house lord under that tradition and emit one +/-1 atomic testimony per satisfied eligible lord-strength condition.
atomic_testimony.no_condition: A mapped significator with no eligible strength/debility condition emits no testimony.
atomic_testimony.duplicates: The same planet may legitimately create separate atomic testimonies through distinct mapped significator roles/conditions only in the raw-stacking arm. Collapse arms remove this multiplicity.
atomic_testimony.counterevidence: Positive and negative testimonies are symmetric in sign; no post-result exception is allowed.

behavior.supported_relation: behavioral_confidence is multiplied by the chart testimony state

domain_collapse_nonstack.rule: For each behavioral domain across all traditions, +1 if at least one positive atomic testimony and no negative atomic testimony; -1 if at least one negative and no positive; 0 for mixed or none. Multiply by behavioral confidence. Sum domains.

cross_tradition_convergence_stack.rule: Apply the same conflict-preserving collapse separately inside each tradition/domain, then sum the up-to-one +/- vote from each tradition times behavioral confidence.

raw_independent_testimony_stack.rule: Sum every distinct +/- atomic testimony across all frozen mapped significators and traditions, each multiplied by behavioral confidence. Do not add project-authored salience/directness coefficients.
raw_independent_testimony_stack.max_stack_per_domain: unbounded by collapse; bounded only by the frozen registry's atomic conditions

direct_regression.per_arm_pass: Target score must be strictly greater than persistent_2013 and no same-date alternative may score strictly greater than target. Same-date ties are screening-pass ties, not final unique-time recovery.
direct_regression.overall_dev_pass: Primary domain_collapse_nonstack must pass AND at least one stacking sensitivity arm must pass.
direct_regression.century_rank_admission: Only overall_dev_pass admits broader V1.3 century ranking. No arm may be retuned after result reveal.
